- [Manage S3 access keys](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/manage-object-storage/manage-s3-access-keys.md): Create, delete, and rotate S3 access keys for Gcore object storage, including read-only keys and credential replacement.

- [Protect objects from deletion with Object Lock](https://docs.gcore.com/storage/manage-object-storage/protect-objects-with-object-lock.md): S3 Object Lock prevents object deletion or modification for a set retention period and must be enabled when creating a bucket.

# Gcore DDoS protection

> Gcore DDoS Protection guards servers and networks from distributed denial-of-service attacks, with free basic and paid advanced mitigation.

- [DDoS protection](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection.md): Gcore DDoS Protection guards servers and networks from distributed denial-of-service attacks, with free basic and paid advanced mitigation.
- [About DDoS Protection](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/about-ddos-protection.md): Gcore DDoS Protection offers free Basic and paid Advanced modes, comparing detection speed, traffic coverage, attack types, and pricing.

## Setting up the service
- [Service activation](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/service-activation.md): Activate Gcore advanced protection by choosing a plan, submitting a network, getting NOC approval, and applying settings.
- [Plan activation](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/plan-activation.md): Activate a Gcore DDoS Protection plan with a 7-day free trial, choosing clean traffic volume and network prefixes for GRE tunneling.
- [Network submission](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/network-submission.md): Submit a network for DDoS Protection by providing CIDR details, AS number, and a Letter of Authorization, then track NOC approval status.
- [Review and approval](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/review-and-approval.md): Network submission review and approval covers NOC checks, email notifications, and status changes for approval, rejection, or revocation.
- [Network configuration](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/network-configuration.md): Configure an approved protected network in Gcore DDoS Protection by setting the GRE endpoint IP and protection profile.
- [Custom protection profile configuration](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/custom-protection-profile-configuration.md): Create custom protection profiles with rules and policies for DDoS protection based on network traffic and security requirements.
- [Apply a custom profile to a protected network](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/apply-a-custom-profile-to-a-protected-network.md): Apply a custom DDoS protection profile to a protected network to activate its rules and policy.
- [Set a GRE tunnel with Gcore](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/gre-tunneling/set-a-gre-tunnel-with-gcore.md): Set up a GRE tunnel with Gcore for DDoS protection using Cisco routers or Ubuntu, including BGP and MTU settings.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/troubleshooting.md): Fix common network setup issues like submission errors, pending status, profile dropdown problems, and attack notification gaps.
- [Traffic Analytics](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/traffic-analytics.md): Traffic Analytics shows live DDoS traffic, mitigation decisions, top talkers, and clean P95 volume for protected resources.
- [DDoS log and monitoring](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/events-log.md): Review DDoS attack events from the past three months, event details, traffic graphs, source breakdowns, and attack email notifications.
- [API Access](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/api-access.md): List and retrieve DDoS event logs with filters for date range, alert type, and targeted IP addresses.

# Gcore WAAP

> Gcore WAAP provides web application and service protection against attacks, bots, abuse, and common vulnerabilities.

- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/overview.md): Gcore WAAP provides web application and service protection against attacks, bots, abuse, and common vulnerabilities.

## Getting started
- [Configure WAAP for a new domain](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/getting-started/configure-waap-for-a-domain.md): Set up WAAP protection for a new domain by adding it, enabling it in CDN settings, monitoring traffic, and switching to Protection mode.
- [WAAP-protected domain management](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/getting-started/manage-domains.md): Manage WAAP protected domains by disabling protection, removing domains, suspending or deleting CDN resources, and checking domain statuses.
- [Billing](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/getting-started/billing.md): WAAP billing plans, billing units, domain zones, plan management, trials, and professional services are explained.

## Analytics
- [WAAP Analytics](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/analytics/waap-analytics.md): WAAP Analytics provides security teams visibility into protected domains, traffic patterns, attacks, and mitigation actions.
- [Dashboard](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/analytics/dashboard.md): Monitor WAAP traffic, attacks, and protection effectiveness across account and domain scopes with the Dashboard.
- [Events](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/analytics/events.md): Investigate WAAP security events and HTTP requests with filtering, inspection, and export options for incident response.
- [Domains](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/analytics/domains.md): Find protected applications and services in Gcore WAAP Domains and start domain-specific security analysis for incident investigation.

## Firewall
- [Access control](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/firewall/access-control.md): Gcore WAAP access control covers IP allowlists and blocklists, IP reputation, Check IP, CDN security policies, and custom rules.
- [IP allowlist and blocklist](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/firewall/ip-allowlist-and-blocklist.md): Manage IP allowlist and blocklist rules in Gcore WAAP to permit or deny IPv4 and IPv6 traffic by address or range.
- [IP Reputation](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/firewall/ip-reputation.md): Configure IP Reputation policies in Gcore WAAP to block, challenge, or allow traffic from TOR, proxies, VPNs, hosting services, and bots.
- [Check IP](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/firewall/check-ip.md): Verify the reputation of an IP address detected by WAAP and review its reputation tags and detection time.
- [L7 DDoS protection](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/ddos-protection.md): L7 DDoS protection detects application layer attacks and activates DDoS mode, with WAAP monitoring or protection modes.

## Default Rules
- [WAAP policies](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies.md): WAAP policies block malicious traffic, prevent data breaches, and filter suspicious IPs and bot traffic, with customizable policy groups.
- [OWASP threats](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/waf-and-owasp-top-threats.md): Configure WAF OWASP Top 10 threat rules, including CSRF checks, policy states, and enable or disable options.
- [Behavioral WAF](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/behavioral-waf.md): Configure Behavioral WAF rules to block brute-force attacks, probing, and obfuscated threats in Gcore WAAP.
- [CMS protection](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/cms-protection.md): Gcore WAAP CMS protection rules allow admin sessions, allowlist static IPs, and manage policies to prevent blocked CMS admin access.

## Custom Rules
- [WAAP rules](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules.md): WAAP rules define request inspection criteria and actions to block threats like SQL injection and cross-site scripting.
- [Custom Rules](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/custom-rules.md): Custom rules for Gcore WAAP define conditions and actions to allow, block, or challenge web requests, with rate limit and tag rules.
- [Rate-Limiting](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/advanced-rules/advanced-rate-limiting-rules.md): Gcore WAAP advanced rate limiting rules control request counts within time windows using filters and exclusions.

## Advanced rules
- [Advanced Rules](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/advanced-rules.md): Create and manage advanced rules with Common Expression Language conditions, actions, rate limiting, and best practices.
- [Advanced rule objects and attributes](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/advanced-rules/advanced-rule-objects.md): Reference for advanced rule objects and attributes, including operators for Dict-type attributes in Gcore filtering rules.
- [Source field objects in advanced rule expressions](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/advanced-rules/source-field-objects.md): Source field objects for advanced rule expressions cover request, whois, session, response, tags, user-agent, and clientdata attributes.

## Tag rules
- [Tag rules](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/custom-rules/tag-rules.md): Create tag-based and tag-generating rules in Gcore WAAP to filter incoming traffic using predefined or user-defined tags.
- [Reserved tags](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/custom-rules/tag-rules/reserved-tags.md): Reserved tags are preconfigured tags that trigger actions in custom rules for WAAP traffic, login pages, automation, and LLM resources.
- [Predefined tags and their descriptions](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-rules/custom-rules/tag-rules/predefined-tags.md): Predefined tags generated by behavioral analysis help filter and sanction web requests, with descriptions and slugs for each tag.

## Bot Management
- [Bot Protection](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/troubleshooting/enable-troubleshoot-bot-protection.md): Enable and troubleshoot Gcore Bot Protection, manage known bots, apply Lets Encrypt policy, and verify allowed bots and security actions.
- [Known Bots](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/known-bots.md): Recognize and allow legitimate bot traffic in WAAP with Known Bots, covering bot categories, verification, and bot mode settings.
- [Anti-automation and bot protection](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/anti-automation-and-bot-protection.md): Configure WAAP anti-automation and bot protection rules to block scanners, spam, headless browsers, and scraping.
- [Invalid user agent and Unknown user agent](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/invalid-user-agent-and-unknown-user-agent.md): WAAP bot management policies for invalid and unknown user agents detect and block requests missing standard browser identifiers.

## Threat Intelligence

## Security Insights
- [Security Insights](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/threat-intelligence/security-insights/security-insights.md): Security Insights sends system-generated alerts about domain misconfigurations, rule mismanagement, and vulnerabilities with fixes.
- [View and investigate insights](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/threat-intelligence/security-insights/view-insights.md): View and investigate WAAP security insights, including attack on disabled policy and allowed high-risk IP, with statuses and use cases.
- [Manage insight status](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/threat-intelligence/security-insights/manage-insights.md): Manage insight status by marking insights as read, silencing notifications, closing, and reopening them.
- [Manage Silence Rules](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/threat-intelligence/security-insights/manage-silence-rules.md): List, update, and delete silence rules for Gcore Security Insights to manage alert notifications and silence durations.
- [TLS fingerprinting with JA3 and JA4](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/threat-intelligence/tls-fingerprinting.md): TLS fingerprinting with JA3 and JA4 identifies clients by handshake parameters, with events, rules, and incident examples.
- [IP Spotlight](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/ip-security/ip-spotlight.md): IP Spotlight provides threat analytics for an IP address, showing global and domain activity, risk score, requests, and whois data.

## API Protection
- [API discovery and protection](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/api-discovery-and-protection.md): Endpoint discovery and protection with Gcore WAAP, including base path configuration and access control by reserved tags.
- [API discovery](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/api-discovery-and-protection/api-discovery.md): Discovery scans domain traffic to find REST endpoints, manage baselines, verify potential endpoints, and configure scans.
- [Configure API Protection policies using reserved tags](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/api-discovery-and-protection/configure-api-access-with-reserved-tags.md): Reserved tags configure Protection policies for endpoint authorization, token protection, and sensitive data exposure.
- [Manually add endpoints to the API base path](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/api-discovery-and-protection/configure-api-base-path.md): Manually add or remove endpoints on a domain's base path for WAAP protection and view current configuration.
- [Advanced API protection](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/advanced-api-protection.md): WAAP Advanced protection rules for application interfaces cover auth tokens, sensitive data, invalid traffic, and authorization.
- [Protocol validation](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/waap-policies/protocol-validation.md): Configure protocol validation rules for HTTP and HTTPS requests in WAAP Bot Management to block non-compliant traffic.

## Response pages
- [Response pages](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/response-pages.md): WAAP response pages cover browser validation, captcha, block, CSRF, and DDoS challenges shown for suspicious or malicious traffic.
- [Create custom response pages](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/response-pages/create-custom-response-pages.md): Create custom WAAP response pages for blocked, captcha, and browser validation messages, then associate page sets with domains.
- [Manage custom response pages](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/response-pages/manage-custom-response-pages.md): Manage custom response pages at account and domain levels, including page sets, updates, assignments, and deletion.
- [View WAAP statistics in Grafana](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/view-waap-statistics-in-grafana.md): Install the Gcore Grafana plugin, connect WAAP statistics, and build dashboards for protected domains and alerts.

## Terraform
- [Manage WAAP via Terraform v0](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/manage-waap-via-terraform.md): Manage WAAP domains, security policies, custom rules, advanced rules, and firewall rules as code with the Gcore provider.

## FAQs
- [Frequently asked questions](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/frequently-asked-questions.md): Find answers to common questions about WAAP, including JavaScript injection, required cookies, and storage variables.
- [How does WAAP JavaScript injection work?](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/frequently-asked-questions/javascript-injection.md): WAAP JavaScript injection adds a challenge to responses to fingerprint clients and detect automated traffic.
- [What are the required cookies used by WAAP?](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/frequently-asked-questions/waap-cookies.md): Gcore WAAP required cookies support behavior analysis, sessions, CSRF protection, CAPTCHA validation, and DDoS protection.
- [What storage variables does WAAP use?](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/frequently-asked-questions/storage-variables.md): WAAP uses local storage variables cnv, csr, otr, and altutgv2 to save key value pairs in a web browser, separate from cookies.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/troubleshooting.md): Find fixes for common Gcore WAAP issues, including bot protection, blocked users, and 5xx errors.
- [Troubleshoot blocked users](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/troubleshooting/troubleshoot-blocked-users.md): Find why WAAP blocked or challenged a user by searching requests with a reference ID and inspecting rule details.
- [Troubleshoot 5xx errors](https://docs.gcore.com/waap/troubleshooting/troubleshoot-5xx-errors.md): Diagnose 500-class WAAP server errors, including 543 when all origin servers are down or unreachable, and review common causes and fixes.
